coverage_note: English-only stretch 11:00-20:30 (AI / transcription talk). Latin-transliterated Arabic 12:27-13:25, 20:31-27:00 and 28:22-1:00:46 (the whole basat / inbasat drill); Arabic script only at the start and after 1:00:53. Honey-seller interruption 22:49-25:00 (English, not lesson). Many of Medi's lines are split onto '?:' lines (e.g. 01:52/01:55 'أنا لقيت الطريق منيح كتير', 04:44, 36:05 'بساتِتك. بَسْتَكْ.' is Amal). Possible swapped label: 25:29 'Amal: Ma biheb asal lana kateer' reads like Medi (I don't like honey alone much). 25:05-25:15 garbled Latin (bihna binkhales al-asal / ahana shay na'na' ma asal mufrad) - not judged. 38:37 he said بسطته (basatto = I made him happy), she echoed 'Basato. Basato.' - unclear, not judged. echo: 'Luka. Software luka.' (00:59) = لغة; 'Qwaad?' / 'quad' (07:34, 07:43) = قواعد; 'Bas,' (12:27) = بس; 'ban biscuit' (58:36) = بنبسط; 'Babysit.' (31:07, Amal) = ببسط; 'Investii' (59:45) = انبسطي; 'embaixoet' (53:13) = انبسطت. 'How' (00:55) and 'Work.' (42:45) are real English. 00:39 'software لقة' (software-language, English word order) left unfiled: he broke off to ask the word. Root-letter slips بنسبت / بسبت for بنبسط / ببسط (21:08, 32:30, 34:21, 56:04, 1:01:34) treated as S4 pronunciation, not filed. Vowel-length drills (beset/basat 29:37, imbestu/imbasatu 51:42) = F2, not filed. 'Kam marra?' 28:29 = kaman marra, not filed.

rows.medi_said: How do you say languages in it? Loka, lokat?
rows.why: He asked how to say language(s) and guessed lokat; she supplied لغة - a didn't-know, not a slip (engine wrote لقة at 00:39, k for غ is pronunciation).

rows.medi_said: يعني ،شو يعني شو لا-- what... What language?
rows.amal_said: No بلاقي، إنتا بتلاقي، شو لقيت؟
rows.why: He did not recognise her لقيت (what did you find?) and asked; she taught بلاقي / بتلاقي / لقيت - a didn't-know on a sheet word (find | Laa2i | لاقي), listening side.

rows.medi_said: أنا لقيت الطريق منيح كتير في research.
rows.why: He said طريق (road) for 'a way / method'; she asked طريق أو طريقة؟ and he fixed to طريقة (sheet: way / method | Tariqa | طريقة).
rows.english: I found a very good way (method) in research

rows.medi_said: أنا لقيت الطريق منيح كتير في research.
rows.why: Once the noun is the feminine طريقة the adjective should be منيحة, and 'a good way' is new information so no el-; she only fixed the noun and let the rest pass.
rows.english: I found a very good way

rows.medi_said: الأحسن طريقة
rows.why: He put el- on the comparative (الأحسن); she recast 'شو أحسن طريقة' twice - C3: never el- in front of a7san.

rows.medi_said: To learn would be أتأل-- or يتعلّم or-
rows.why: For 'the best way to learn' he offered the he-form يتعلّم; she said لا أتعلم (I-form after a7san tari2a). Half a question ('would be ... or'), so low.
rows.english: the best way for me to learn

rows.medi_said: Okay. أتعلم لغة جديد
rows.why: لغة is feminine, the adjective stayed masculine جديد; she moved on without fixing it.

rows.medi_said: بس أحسا-- بحسا آم مشكلة كتير مع عربي فلسطيني.
rows.why: 'A lot of problems' needs the plural مشاكل; he kept the singular. Let pass. (Could also be read as 'a big problem', hence low.)
rows.english: but I feel I have a lot of problems with Palestinian Arabic

rows.medi_said: مع عربي فلسطيني. آم
rows.why: A known, specific thing (the Palestinian Arabic) takes el- after the preposition; he said it bare. Let pass.

rows.medi_said: بقدر آم أصلح، أصلحه آم…
rows.amal_said: أصلّحها بي لأنه مشكلة is a feminine.
rows.why: The object ending on the verb pointed at مشكلة must be feminine -ha; he used -o and she named the rule ('because مشكلة is feminine').
rows.english: if I can fix it (the problem)

rows.medi_said: I excited؟ أنا بهمس.
rows.why: He said ba7ammes (I excite someone; engine wrote ه for ح) for 'I get excited'; she recast بتحمس - the make-X / get-X pair.

rows.medi_said: shit! أنا بتحمس. amm أنا بتحمس شو بنقدر
rows.amal_said: So neither not تحمس not بهمِس. What is it?
rows.why: He meant the state 'I am excited' but used the verb بتحمس; she asked 'you are excited or you get excited?', said neither verb fits, and he produced متحمس (sheet: excited | mit7ammes | متحمس) - adjective vs verb is a wrong form of a word he knows (participle, B15 not yet taught).

rows.medi_said: متحمس من possibility.
rows.why: Her sheet gives متحمس لَ (excited | mit7ammes | متحمس لَ); he used من. Let pass.

rows.medi_said: أي كلمات، مشكلة، مشكل-- yeah. عندي
rows.proposed_rule: After ayy (which / any) the noun stays singular, like after kam: ayy kelme, not ayy kelmaat
rows.why: He said أي كلمات (any words); she recast أي كلمة and he repeated it at 07:12. No bucket covers ayy + singular (E5 is kam only).
rows.english: which words do I have a problem with

rows.medi_said: أي كلمة مشكلة اللي-
rows.why: 'The word I have a problem with' - he stalled at اللي; she finished it with عندي مشكلة فيها (the preposition carries the pointer -ha back to the word), and he repeated it at 07:18.
rows.english: which word I have a problem with

rows.medi_said: عندي مشكلة فيها وووه، il grammar. Do I know grammar?
rows.why: He asked 'Do I know grammar?'; she supplied قواعد (not on her sheet, so not tier 3) - a didn't-know.

rows.medi_said: Do I know the word for repeat? Is it تكرار？
rows.amal_said: Repeat يعني أنا بعيد is I repeat.
rows.why: He asked the word for 'repeat' and offered تكرار; she explained تكرار is repetition and the verb is بعيد - a didn't-know.

rows.medi_said: ana بعيد الـ، الـ نفس مش الـ-
rows.why: He put el- on نفس; she said No, نفس المشكلة (sheet: the same… | Nafs + el + noun) - el- goes on the second word. He said 'الـ نفس مشكلة' again at 08:44 - same moment, one row.

rows.medi_said: مش ذكي. ل-لما الـ سؤال ما عند-- ما عنده، جواب
rows.amal_said: صحيح. لما ما يكون عنده جواب للـ السؤال
rows.wrong: لما الـ سؤال ما عنده جواب
rows.right: لما ما يكون عنده جواب للسؤال
rows.why: In the lamma clause she recast with يكون (lamma ma ykoon 3indo jawab); his version had no ykoon. She said صحيح first, so medium.
rows.english: when it doesn't have an answer to the question

rows.medi_said: a test. أنا بعمل test إللي ع-ماا، possible solutions-
rows.why: He is telling what he did ('that's what you did' at 10:56) but used the present بعمل; past عملت needed. Let pass. 'test' is not on her sheet, so not tier 3.
rows.english: I did a test of possible solutions

rows.medi_said: ... ووا ال أول مشكلة.
rows.why: أول + noun is an idafa; the first word takes no el-. Let pass.

rows.medi_said: al-, el ghayr tariqa-
rows.why: He put el- in front of ghayr (another way); she said 'Not el, just ghayr tariqa'.

rows.medi_said: I don't know how to do, sehel ktir.
rows.why: She echoed his phrase with ktir in front; may be a word-order recast or just a question ('very easy?'), so low.

rows.medi_said: muhadatha ma qalil kalima.
rows.amal_said: actually, can we just get bansabat
rows.why: 'With few words' - adjective should follow the noun and agree (كلمات قليلة); he put the adjective first and singular. Let pass.

rows.medi_said: So that was zaj. What shuu, shu yanni banzaj?
rows.why: He asked what banzaj means; she taught it (sheet: i get annoyed | Banz3ej | بنزعج) - a didn't-know.

rows.medi_said: بحرج، بحرج، شو يعني؟
rows.right: بحرج = I embarrass; بنحرج = I get embarrassed
rows.why: He asked the meaning of بحرج / بنحرج; she gave it - a didn't-know (not on her sheet).

rows.medi_said: maruj baru... Is it m-maruj? M-mitruj?
rows.why: He guessed the adjective 'embarrassed' and asked; she supplied محروج and he repeated it - a didn't-know.

rows.medi_said: il, il zalama and, ando... Oh my God, bees. What was bees? Bee.
rows.why: He asked 'What was bees?'; she supplied نحل (sheet: bees (general) | Na7el | نحل) and he repeated it - a didn't-know.

rows.medi_said: Ana hakeet ma khatibti ashan Arabiyi. Arabiyi, aswad or-
rows.why: For 'my Arabic is bad / getting worse' the engine wrote aswad (black, sheet: black | Aswad); she supplied سيء (sheet: bad | Sayyi2). He may have said aswa2 (worse, sheet: worse | Aswa2) and the engine wrote aswad - low.
rows.english: I talked with my fiancée because my Arabic is bad / getting worse

rows.medi_said: getting worse so she would it be akun, akunsayye'?
rows.why: For 'is getting bad' he reached for أكون (be); she recast with بصير (become) - a different verb for the meaning (3am = B14, shown only). He repeated 'baseer sayyee'.

rows.medi_said: بنسبت؟ But-
rows.amal_said: No, forget everything. Bas ihkili shi ya'ani happy as a siffa.
rows.why: Asked 'what is happy?' he gave the verb بنبسط (engine بنسبت, root-letter slip = pronunciation); she said No, the adjective (siffa), and he got to مبسوط at 27:54 - verb form for the adjective he knows (sheet: happy | Mabsoo6 | مبسوط).

rows.medi_said: sorry هية بتيبست- يبستوا and احنا بين- بينبست.
rows.why: For 'we' he used the he-prefix بي- (byebset); she prompted احنا and he fixed to بنبسط (confirmed بنبسط at 34:24-34:26). The بنسبت root slip in his fix is pronunciation, not filed.

rows.medi_said: sorry هية بتيبست- يبستوا and احنا بين- بينبست.
rows.why: The they-form came out without the present b- (yebsetu); she only fixed the next item. Engine may have dropped the b-, so low.

rows.medi_said: Did i make you... اه بسات- بساتِ- بساتِتني أسف
rows.why: For 'did I make YOU happy' he put -ni (me) on the verb; she recast بسطتك / بستك and he took it ('Ok بسَتَّكْ' at 36:13). The '?:' line at 36:05 is hers.

rows.medi_said: So yeah, بسّت، بسτι. بسّت.
rows.amal_said: No. ليش ما منحط إي بدنا إي
rows.why: He asserted the command as bare بسّت (no vowel in front); she said No, we need the i- (إبسط, three consonants) and he fixed to أبست / ابست، ابستي، ابسطو at 44:25.

rows.medi_said: is it nabasit or is it, nabasat? Or nabast?
rows.amal_said: So now we do need to add something to make it easier to say. ... So inbasat.
rows.why: He asked the past form of banbeset; she supplied انبسط and he repeated it - a form he had not learned, didn't-know.

rows.medi_said: embasana.
rows.why: The we-past lost the stem's final t before -na (inbasat-na); she recast and he repeated. Could be a slurred t, so low.

rows.medi_said: this would be embasattet, right? Embassatet il hafla.
rows.why: 'Did you (f) enjoy' needs the -ti ending; he gave the I / you-m form -et and she recast انبسطتي.

rows.medi_said: Embassatet il hafla.
rows.amal_said: EMBASATI. I need a preposition. What was it? Do you remember?
rows.why: انبسط takes bi / fi before its object; he dropped it, she prompted 'I need a preposition', he said 'I forget', she gave 'Bi or fi' and he rebuilt it at 54:40 (embasati fi el hafleh).

rows.medi_said: In basatu Their trip. Safarhom. Safarhom.
rows.why: Same rule as 53:36, new sentence: he again dropped bi after انبسط; she prompted 'fee preposition, shoo?' and he fixed 'Bi safar hom'.

rows.medi_said: In basatu Their trip. Safarhom. Safarhom.
rows.why: 'Their trip' is سفرة + -hom; the feminine -t must appear before the owner ending (sheet: (travel) trip | Safra | سفرة). He said safar-hom; she recast safrethom and he repeated 'Safarthom'.

rows.medi_said: Ana, ana ban biscuit. ashann ihna aa taalam natal ana naataallam
rows.why: 'I get happy because we learn' - 3ashan meaning 'because' keeps the present b-; he said bare nit3allam (and wavered ana / ihna), she recast ihna bnet3allam and he repeated it.
rows.english: I get happy because we are learning

rows.medi_said: ihna bantalaam bass Hadi al filll
rows.why: فعل (verb) is masculine; he said hadi, she recast hada and he repeated 'Hada al fill' (then 'bass hadal fil', confirmed yes).

rows.medi_said: Enjoy your day So command tensing Investii yomek
rows.why: Third time this lesson: انبسط + bi before its object; he said inbesti yomek, she supplied 'bi yomek'. He then asked to put the preposition in the homework.

rows.medi_said: So الأكتر إشي-
rows.why: el- on the comparative again (cf. 02:15); she said 'No el, just أكتر إشي' and he repeated أكثر إشي.
rows.english: the thing that makes you happiest (most)

rows.medi_said: بيبسطني لماaa would this be conditional؟ لما بكون في الطبيعة؟
rows.why: After lamma the b- drops; he said بكون, she recast لما أكون and he took it ('لما اكون yeah. I knew it was conditional').
rows.english: what makes me happiest is when I am in nature

rows.medi_said: to make someone happy is آآá بيسبط.
rows.why: Asked for 'to make someone happy' (her dictionary form babse6) he gave the he-form bi-; she recast ببسّط and he repeated it; she then drilled 'ببسط' five times. The missing root ب in the engine's بيسبط is pronunciation, so low.

rows.medi_said: عافيا فيكي. شكرًا.
rows.why: The reply to يعطيك العافية is the set phrase الله يعافيكي; his 'عافيا فيكي' is a mangled form of it. She let it pass.
rows.english: and you too (reply to 'may God give you health')
